acceptanceCriteria: Omitted start verification retains the observed default command for Cargo repositories.
A non-empty explicit verification list supplied through CLI or MCP becomes the Contract list and no verification subprocess is launched by start itself.

A successor created before retirement can activate after retirement adds its required Outcome only when the replacement manifest and retirement receipt bind the exact predecessor and successor identities.
Unrelated Outcome appearance or identity mismatch remains rejected.
Regression tests exercise the full recovery-to-replacement-to-successor-activation sequence and reject an unrelated archive Outcome.
Regression tests prove explicit verification values reach the repository Contract through CLI/MCP-facing parsing while omitted values retain the default.
goal: Make start-time verification explicit when supplied while preserving defaults, and allow the recorded recovery-to-replacement sequence to validate the retirement-generated Outcome without weakening identity checks.
intent: Repair the Runtime lifecycle boundary that prevents a documentation Work Item from declaring bounded verification and prevents its formally replaced successor from activating after retirement adds an Outcome.
